macros.name: currentexercisepoints
macros.doc: \currentexercisepoints expands to the current exercise total points.

macros.name: currentexercisetitle
macros.doc: \currentexercisetitle expands to the exercise title supplied as (optional) argument to the exercise environment.

macros.name: getpoints
macros.doc: \getpoints{x} expands to the total points of the exercise number x (starting with 0).

macros.name: numberofexercises
macros.doc: \numberofexercises expands to the number of all exercises in the document.

macros.name: totalpoints
macros.doc: \totalpoints expands to the sum of all points of all exercises in the document.
